displayDescription: A white architectural model lights up as a projected blue network and the CONNECTED SYSTEM label sweep out from the idea tower.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, sound effects or narration.
limitations: No Blender was used. The model is built with Three.js boxes and standard materials with soft shadows.

Projection is an approximation: a plan-aligned decal texture is mixed into surfaces that face up, coming from a straight-overhead projector. The faint beam is drawn as see-through haze, not volumetric light.
No reviewed preview recipes or background-review evidence were supplied, so the preview shows the style's main action.
The illustrative block layout is invented; it is not based on supplied real-world footprints.
The project technology selection tool failed because PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json is missing; the runtime libraries are local files (three.bundle.js, gsap.min.js).
